page.mask_url: `mask_url` points to a PNG alpha mask whose size must match the first reference image, and it requires `image_urls`.
page.image_urls: For image-to-image editing, add `image_urls` to the same JSON request, up to 16 images. URLs must be reachable by the server. You can get URLs through the [image upload API](https://docs.toapis.com/docs/en/api-reference/uploads/images.md) first. Reference images are billed as image input tokens.
page.size: Aspect-ratio names (such as `1:1`, `3:2`, `2:3`, `16:9`, `9:16`) or pixel sizes (such as `1024x1024`, `1536x1024`). For GIF output see the GIF section for size semantics. Pixel dimensions must be multiples of 16 on both sides, the longest edge must not exceed 3840, and total pixels must be between 655,360 and 8,294,400; sizes beyond 2560x1440 are experimental.

params.source: https://docs.toapis.com/docs/en/api-reference/images/gpt-image-2.6-official/generation.md, "Request parameters", "Reference images and masks", "Markup-guided editing", "GIF output", "SVG output", read 2026-11-06

size.description: an aspect-ratio name or WxH (multiples of 16, edge at most 3840, 655,360 to 8,294,400 px); default auto

mask_url.description: a PNG alpha mask the size of the first reference image; requires image_urls; excludes markup_url
